product.title: Eat Osaka: Street Food Cooking in an Authentic Kitchen!

description.text: In Osaka, this hands-on street-food class meets at a published working kitchen for a cooking session, then a shared meal of the dishes cooked in class. The format suits visitors who want a kitchen window focused on Osaka street-food techniques rather than a market tasting walk. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Osaka, and the itinerary stays on the street-food kitchen and shared meal table that define this class rather than a Shinsekai night crawl.

highlights: Shared meal of the cooked dishes

end.description: Return to your Osaka meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
